mechanism_note: not insert latency and not a request-triggered flush: 0.25-2.0 s of delay and an intervening unrelated request both leave the miss at 100%, while a second identical repeat hits 10/10. The prefix becomes reusable only after it has been prefilled twice, so a multiple-of-64 workload loses one full prefill per new prefix.
next_unit_hint: Paper must carry the operational warning: a workload whose prompt length is a multiple of 64 pays one full prefill per new prefix (delay does not help; only re-sending the same prompt does).
